// Evidence-backed Persona 4 function names.
//
// config/symbol_addrs.txt is REGENERATED by tools/reconcile_function_boundaries.py
// and only holds func_<address> placeholders; this file is the curated overlay
// that survives regeneration. One line per recovered name:
//
//     Name = 0xADDRESS; // type:func  evidence: <how the name was established>
//
// Rules enforced by tools/reconcile_function_boundaries.py::curated_names and
// tests/test_symbol_names.py:
//   - the address must be a canonical function boundary
//   - the name must not be a func_<hex>/FUN_<hex> placeholder
//   - an `evidence:` note is mandatory; "looks like" is not evidence
//   - names and addresses must both be unique
//
// Accepted evidence, strongest first:
//   p3:<P3Name>@<p3 address>  a unique address-normalized P3 counterpart that
//                             carries this name in the P3 decomp
//   file:<name>.c             an embedded __FILE__ assert string referenced from
//                             this function's translation unit
//   string:"<text>"           a debug/panic string uniquely referenced here
//   caller:<addr>             an already-named caller that fixes this role
//
// Recovered by tools/mine_name_strings.py class A ({name,fn} record
// adjacency) in the run that produced the 89-entry symbol_names.strings.txt,
// and preserved here because the current record-adjacency rule no longer
// derives them: re-running the miner drops these three addresses entirely,
// and config/symbol_addrs.txt is regenerated from this family, so leaving
// them to the producer would silently delete them.
btlAct_SKILL_RECITE_E = 0x001BFC00; // type:func  evidence: string:"SKILL_RECITE_E"
btlAct_SKILL_EXEC_ONE = 0x001C6B60; // type:func  evidence: string:"SKILL_EXEC_ONE"
btlAct_TARGET = 0x001CC9E0; // type:func  evidence: string:"TARGET"

// Native source markers disambiguate the MWSTM error-string callee from its wrapper.

MWSTM_ReqStart = 0x00512238; // type:func  evidence: source:src/cri/re4/mwstm.c FUN_00512238 delegates to ADXSTM_Start

// Resource teardown: retail debug prints "delete <kind> res" per resource type.
